basic_details.job_title: DLSA Kannur Para Legal Volunteer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Applicants who have passed 10th standard can apply to work as Para Legal Volunteers with the District Legal Services Authority (ജില്ലാ ലീഗൽ സർവ്വീസസ് അതോറിറ്റി), Kannur @ Thalassery. The application, with the applicant's photograph, must reach the DLSA office at the District Court Complex, Thalassery - 670101 before 5 PM on 20 November 2026, and selection is by interview. As of 9 November 2026 the application period is open.

qualification.details: Post: Para Legal Volunteer. Educational qualification: Applicants must have passed 10th standard. Desirable: Minimum computer knowledge. Who can apply: Teachers, retired government employees, Anganwadi workers, doctors, law students, workers of non-political voluntary organisations, Kudumbashree workers, and NCC and NSS volunteers, among others. Pay: An honorarium is given for the service, but Para Legal Volunteers should not be people who see the service as a means of income. The amount of the honorarium is not specified in the notice. Training: Those selected will be given training. | Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions for the Para Legal Volunteer post.

selection_process: Selection of Para Legal Volunteers will be on the basis of an interview. The interview date and venue are not specified in the notice.
important_instructions: Para Legal Volunteers currently working in the district who wish to continue must apply again. Such existing volunteers must surrender their current identity card at the office before attending the interview. In the declaration, the applicant confirms that the details are true to the best of their knowledge and belief. The applicant also declares readiness to carry out the work directed by the District Legal Services Authority or Taluk Legal Services Committee offices without expecting remuneration. The applicant agrees to be removed from the Para Legal Volunteer panel if they do not do so.

content_sections.heading: About DLSA Kannur
content_sections.text: The District Legal Services Authority, Kannur @ Thalassery functions from the District Court Complex, Thalassery - 670101. The notice is issued by its Secretary, who is a Civil Judge (Senior Division). Its office can be contacted on phone 0490 2344666 and by email at [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application must reach the District Legal Services Authority, Kannur @ Thalassery, District Court Complex, Thalassery - 670101 before 5 PM on 20 November 2026. The notice says the application must be received at "this office" by that time; it does not mention whether it should be sent by post or delivered by hand, and it does not ask for anything to be written on the envelope. Use the application form (അപേക്ഷാഫോറം) printed on page 2 of the notice. It asks for: Name Age Female/Male Name of father/mother/husband Address, including house number and PIN code Block Panchayat Phone number and email address Educational qualification Occupation Experience in the field of social service, with details Whether interested in legal service activities Whether involved in any criminal case, with details Area chosen for work, stating whether at district level or taluk level Whether currently a Para Legal Volunteer, with details (district, taluk) The form ends with a declaration (സത്യവാങ്മൂലം), signed with place, date and name.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Post: Para Legal Volunteer. Educational qualification: Applicants must have passed 10th standard. Desirable: Minimum computer knowledge. Who can apply: Teachers, retired government employees, Anganwadi workers, doctors, law students, workers of non-political voluntary organisations, Kudumbashree workers, and NCC and NSS volunteers, among others. Pay: An honorarium is given for the service, but Para Legal Volunteers should not be people who see the service as a means of income. The amount of the honorarium is not specified in the notice. Training: Those selected will be given training. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions for the Para Legal Volunteer post.

content_sections.heading: DLSA Kannur Para Legal Volunteer Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice states that the responsibilities of Para Legal Volunteers are to take the following to the people: Free legal aid Legal awareness Alternative dispute resolution mechanisms

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DLSA Kannur Para Legal Volunteer 2026?
faq.answer: The application, with the applicant's photograph, must reach the DLSA office at the District Court Complex, Thalassery before 5 PM on 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the qualification for Para Legal Volunteer in DLSA Kannur?
faq.answer: Applicants must have passed 10th standard; minimum computer knowledge is desirable.

faq.question: Q3. Is the DLSA Kannur Para Legal Volunteer a paid post?
faq.answer: An honorarium is given for the service, but the notice says Para Legal Volunteers should not be people who see the service as a means of income.

faq.question: Q4. How do I apply for DLSA Kannur Para Legal Volunteer 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form on page 2 of the notice, attach your photograph, and make sure it reaches the District Legal Services Authority, Kannur @ Thalassery, District Court Complex, Thalassery - 670101 before 5 PM on 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for Para Legal Volunteers in DLSA Kannur?
faq.answer: Selection will be on the basis of an interview.

faq.question: Q6. Who can apply as a Para Legal Volunteer with DLSA Kannur?
faq.answer: Teachers, retired government employees, Anganwadi workers, doctors, law students, non-political voluntary organisation workers, Kudumbashree workers, and NCC and NSS volunteers, among others, can apply if they have passed 10th standard.

faq.question: Q7. Do existing Para Legal Volunteers in Kannur need to apply again?
faq.answer: Yes. Existing Para Legal Volunteers in the district who want to continue must apply again and surrender their current identity card at the office before attending the interview.

faq.question: Q8. What will Para Legal Volunteers do?
faq.answer: They take free legal aid, legal awareness and alternative dispute resolution mechanisms to the people, and those selected will be given training.
